verdict.rationale: The pack has no reference to DeepSeek on any independent third-party leaderboard or evaluation suite. Community mentions of benchmarks (e.g. "according to these benchmarks") never attribute them to an independent evaluator. An informal user pelican comparison via OpenRouter is anecdotal hands-on testing, not an independent evaluation or leaderboard.

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers
